claim_boundary: No tachyon, controllable FTL channel, or negative-local-time return is claimed to have been observed.
The camera-obscura channel is an optical-delay witness, never the primary causal clock.
The Dirac-belt / spinor layer uses established 2π/4π topology as a register; the JANUS coupling proposed here is a new experimental protocol, not an established law of nature.

SCOBY 'micronuclearity' is introduced here as an operational morphology term for persistent local nucleation-like microdomains; it is not nuclear physics and is not claimed to be a standard biological term.
Scientific novelty is not claimed until external prior-art review, preregistration, controls, and replication.

states.OBSERVED: Directly measured or present in source artifacts.
states.FUTURE_ONLY: Requires a physical capability not currently established.

available_channels.piezo: 1 protected piezoelectric channel sampled at 1 kHz

attached_prototype_bridge.current_limit: No microscopy or direct SCOBY microdomain imager is included in the v0.1 prototype; micronuclearity therefore requires an added imaging channel or ex-situ image analysis.

state_vector.definition: X_J = (tau, J, N, W, nu, chi, Phi, mu, S_skin, P_gamma)

components.tau: local atomic-clock reading at station A
components.J: tau_R - tau_S; local return-minus-send interval measured by the same clock
components.N: unsigned count of registered full loop traversals
components.W: oriented winding, integer sum of per-traversal handed signs
components.Phi: relative spinor/interferometric phase modulo 2π, when implemented

burovchik_method.purpose: Restore the orientation information discarded by the Z2 quotient.

local_definition.k_hat: signed unit tangent of signal propagation at the detector
local_definition.omega: angular-velocity vector of the mechanically or spin-coupled Dirac register

chi_values.+1: right-handed screw coupling: positive rotation advances along propagation direction

dirac_projection.derived_fact: Because +1 ≡ -1 (mod 2), reversing a traversal changes W and chi but not its odd/even Dirac class.

orientation_reversal_map.testability: Directly testable in a non-FTL mechanical or interferometric analog.

memory_hierarchy.name: JANUS Memory Ladder
memory_hierarchy.central_relation: The Z2 register can return to its trivial class after 4π while the oriented winding W and material witness mu can retain evidence that traversals occurred.

scooby_micronuclearity.definition: Persistent local nucleation-like microdomains in a SCOBY/cellulose matrix after a preregistered stimulus, counted by fixed image-analysis rules.

persistence_model.reason: Biological memory is not assumed perfectly irreversible.
persistence_model.T_mem: estimated from sham and stimulus-control runs, never imported from the Carbon-14 analogy

skinGPT_bridge_vector.formula: S_skin = (piezo_peak, piezo_rms, deltaT_max, thermal_spread, accel_mag, gyro_mag)
skinGPT_bridge_vector.role: Confirms that a local physical stimulus occurred and helps reject crosstalk or actuator-failure explanations.

janus_causal_topological_relations.statement: Z2 parity is the mod-2 projection of oriented winding: nu = W mod 2. The Burovchik sign lifts the experiment from parity-only memory to signed winding memory.
janus_causal_topological_relations.falsifier: A calibrated register that reports the same signed W for controlled +2π and -2π traversals.

janus_causal_topological_relations.statement: For a path-reversed traversal, Dirac parity is preserved while Burovchik chirality flips: nu_R = nu_S and chi_R = -chi_S.
janus_causal_topological_relations.falsifier: Repeated path reversal fails to flip chi beyond the preregistered error rate while parity readout remains valid.

janus_causal_topological_relations.statement: Exact closure means F(X_J)=X_J, not merely restoration of the Z2 class. Therefore nu=0 is necessary but not sufficient when W, mu, or other local witnesses retain history.
strong_closure_gate: SkinGPT residual vector within sham confidence region
janus_causal_topological_relations.falsifier: A controlled run passes all strong-closure gates despite a deliberately retained nonzero witness.

janus_causal_topological_relations.statement: A 4π return can be topologically trivial in the Dirac register while a persistent SCOBY morphology or signed winding remains nontrivial; thus topological reset does not imply physical-history erasure.
janus_causal_topological_relations.falsifier: Under frozen imaging and sham controls, the material witness never differs from baseline after validated stimuli.

janus_causal_topological_relations.statement: A candidate causal anomaly requires J<0 on one local atomic clock together with a preregistered local return signature. Remote-clock synchronization or camera ordering alone cannot satisfy the gate.
required_signature: valid event identity / nonce on SEND and RETURN
SkinGPT stimulus witness above sham threshold
all ordinary latency, buffering, timestamp, software and electromagnetic-crosstalk explanations excluded

janus_causal_topological_relations.statement: Optical observation is delayed: t_image = t_event + d/c plus detector latency. Camera-obscura ordering is therefore a secondary witness and may differ from the atomic event log without implying retrocausality.

janus_scoby_paradox.name: JANUS SCOBY Persistent-Witness Paradox
janus_scoby_paradox.logical_form: S -> R -> M -> not-S -> not-R -> not-M -> S
janus_scoby_paradox.operational_rule: If a preregistered pre-SEND SCOBY/telemetry signature M is detected, cancel SEND.
janus_scoby_paradox.interpretation: This is a consistency stress-test for any future mechanism that could make J<0; it is not evidence that such a mechanism exists.
janus_scoby_paradox.safety_note: Use non-hazardous bench stimuli and standard biosafety for the culture; the paradox requires no irradiation, nuclear material or harmful exposure.

camera_obscura.forbidden_interpretation: An image arriving late/early relative to another image is not by itself evidence of altered causal order.

stage_A_non_FTL_orientation.goal: Validate W, nu and chi independently of any causal claim.
stage_A_non_FTL_orientation.setup: Ring or belt register with encoder; controlled +2π/-2π traversals; photon trigger; atomic/precision local timing.
primary_tests: 4π: nu resets while W encoder retains signed history

stage_B_SCOBY_witness.goal: Measure whether a controlled local stimulus creates reproducible fast telemetry and slower morphology beyond sham distributions.
controls: mechanical actuator sham disconnected from SCOBY

stage_C_integrated_closed_loop_analog.goal: Demonstrate that Z2 reset is weaker than strong physical-state closure.
stage_C_integrated_closed_loop_analog.mechanism: Digital controller closes the loop in ordinary forward time; each RETURN triggers the Dirac/Burovchik register and a safe SCOBY stimulus.
stage_C_integrated_closed_loop_analog.expected: nu may return to baseline after even traversals while W and/or mu retain history.

stage_D_negative_J.goal: Apply the same gates only if an independently established physical channel can produce J<0.

null_hypotheses: H0_orientation: chirality readout is unrelated to controlled traversal direction.
H0_morphology: mu changes are drawn from the sham distribution.
H0_skin: SkinGPT event vector is explained by ordinary actuator noise/crosstalk.
H0_causal: all measured returns satisfy J >= 0 after clock and acquisition uncertainty.

recommended_controls.multiple_comparisons: control false discovery rate when scanning many telemetry/morphology features
recommended_controls.anomaly_detection: Z-score or robust equivalent may flag candidates but cannot promote a causal claim without replication
recommended_controls.replication: independent cultures, independent acquisition runs, and ideally independent laboratory replication

statistics_and_gates.promotion_rule: No 'LAW', 'DISCOVERY', or causal-retrocausal claim until prior-art review plus preregistered replicated evidence passes all relevant gates.

expected_contributions_if_validated: Operational lift from Z2 parity to oriented integer winding using a right-hand-screw convention.
Strong-closure criterion distinguishing topological reset from full physical-state reset.
Multimodal living-matrix witness combining fast SkinGPT telemetry with slower SCOBY morphology.
A single-clock causal anomaly gate that explicitly separates event time, photon control time and camera-obscura image time.
